title: Escrowed enactment for Optimize recommendations with canary observability & approval hooks
creator: Marcus Chen
description:
Problem: Optimize produces batching and caching suggestions that can reduce per-token cost but occasionally produce regressions in latency or output quality when applied broadly. We need a production-friendly enactment system that holds suggestions in an operator escrow, performs automated canary experiments (including traffic shadowing and synthetic prefix warmups), and requires human approval to release escalations.

Goals: build an "escrowed enactment" runner that can: 1) stage suggestion artifacts into an escrow state, 2) run an automated canary (configurable traffic mix, shadow mode, KV/prefix cache warmup, synthetic evals), 3) surface canary telemetry (p99 latency, tail jitter, token cost delta, embedding-similarity vs baseline, prompt-set quality regressions), 4) open an approval ticket in Console with summarized findings and one-click approve/reject, 5) provide an automatic rollback and audit trail if conditions breach post-rollout thresholds.

Scope: this ticket implements the core enactment workflow, canary harness integration, Console approval surface, and a minimal policy engine for gating. It will not cover Dedicated autoscaler integration or on-prem install packaging (follow-ups will cover those).

Non-goals: fully-automated unconditional auto-apply, model re-training, deep offline eval pipeline (we will reuse existing eval harness and telemetry).
acceptance_criteria: Escrow UI: suggestions can be moved to an escrow state with metadata and operator notes visible in Console
Canary run: system can execute a canary run against a customer-like traffic mix in shadow or live ramp mode
Metric set: telemetry produced for p50/p95/p99 latency, tail jitter, cost per token delta, KV cache hit-rate, and quality delta on the provided prompt set
Gate policy: configurable gates (latency threshold, cost delta max, quality regression max) can block rollout
Approval flow: Console shows canary summary and requires explicit operator approve/reject before >5% ramp beyond canary window
Rollback: automatic rollback trigger implemented if post-rollout metrics exceed safety thresholds and rollback is recorded in audit logs
Audit trail: every state transition (escrow->canary->ramp->approved->rollback) is logged with operator id, timestamp, and trace ids
E2E tests: integration tests simulate canary failure and successful approval paths and assert correct state transitions
tasks: Design escrow database schema and retention rules (short-lived staging artifacts)
Implement canary harness adapter to drive shadow traffic and synthetic prompts
Integrate existing eval harness for quality checks against prompt-sets
Add policy engine primitives (rules for latency, cost, quality) and config UI in Console
Render canary summary in Console with signal visualizations and one-click approve/reject
Create backend workflow for staged ramps (0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) with timeouts and kill-switch
Implement audit log entries and link to customer-specific logging/Datadog dashboards
Add unit and integration tests, CI job, and a demo-runbook for SREs and PMs
